
```{r}
monthly_indices <- ocean %>%
  # Create a new column that rounds each date down to the first day of its month
  mutate(month_date = floor_date(date, "month")) %>%
  
  # Group data by month
  group_by(month_date) %>%
  
  # Compute monthly averages for each index, ignoring missing values
  summarise(
    avg_enso = mean(enso, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_iod  = mean(iod, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_pdo  = mean(pdo, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  
  # Sort data chronologically by month
  arrange(month_date) %>%
  
  # Create readable month labels BEFORE applying lag
  mutate(
    # Label for the current (target) month
    target_month_year = format(month_date, "%b-%Y"),
    
    # Label for the previous month (used to track lag relationship)
    lagged_month_year = lag(target_month_year)
  ) %>%
  
  # Shift the index values so each row contains the PREVIOUS month's data
  mutate(
    avg_enso = lag(avg_enso),
    avg_iod  = lag(avg_iod),
    avg_pdo  = lag(avg_pdo)
  ) %>%
  
  # Remove the first row since lag() introduces NA values
  filter(!is.na(avg_enso)) %>%
  
  # Reorder columns:
  # - keep target month first
  # - put lagged month second
  # - keep all other columns
  # - remove the raw month_date column
  select(target_month_year, lagged_month_year, everything(), -month_date)

# Output the final dataset
monthly_indices

```
